notes: Camif is a live, active French home-goods retailer (custom platform, Algolia-backed search grid; not Shopify/Magento) with an ethical/Made-in-France positioning; no shutdown/redirect found. Access route: direct fetch worked throughout, no WAF/blocking encountered, no proxy needed. Full category tree obtained from https://www.camif.fr/sitemap.categories.xml (353 URLs) cross-checked against the rendered mega-menu on https://www.camif.fr/c/deco and https://www.camif.fr/c/arts-de-la-table. Counts verified via the rendered French 'N articles' header on each listing page, cross-checked against the count of unique data-product-id product tiles actually present on the page (exact match on every single-page category; for the one paginated category, Objets deco a poser, page 1 (46 unique tile ids) + page 2 (14 unique tile ids) = 60, matching the header exactly with no page 3, so exhaustion confirmed). Site is furniture/bedding/textile-heavy overall (Meubles, Literie, Linge de maison, Canapes) which is out of scope; in-scope decor lives mainly under 'Toute la deco' (/c/deco) plus tableware under 'Arts de la table' (/c/arts-de-la-table) and outdoor lighting under 'Jardin' (/c/jardin/eclairage-d-exterieur). EXCLUDED: Tapis/Tapis d'interieur (rugs, textile); Deco textile - Coussins/Plaids/Rideaux et voilage/Poufs/Housses (all textiles); Linge de table (table linens: nappes, serviettes, sets de table, torchons); Bougies (checked all 10 product titles on the page - every one is 'Bougie parfumee <scent name>', i.e. 100% scented candles, so the whole node was dropped per the Home Fragrance exclusion, no unscented children exist); Vaporisateurs et diffuseurs (diffusers, fragrance); Couverts et menageres (cutlery/flatware, explicit exclusion); Moules a gateaux, Moules a pain, Plats a four (bakeware/cookware siblings of the kept Plats de service/Saladiers under Plats, moules et saladiers); Accessoires de cuisine (kitchen utensils/knives/cutting boards) and its 'Decoration de table' child (checked product titles: 4 of 5 SKUs are placemat sets and napkin-ring sets - table linens/textile accessories - with only one unrelated decorative pot, a mixed roll-up dominated by non-decor items, dropped rather than padded per the mixed-rollup rule); Casseroles-poeles-et-cocottes (cookware); the whole 'professionnels' (C-PRO) branch, a separate B2B/contract furnishing channel, out of scope for the consumer decor catalogue; 'Art de recevoir' (no sitemap children, a curated marketing landing page, not a real taxonomy leaf, treated like Collections/Featured). Rule 0.6 overlap: 'Objets deco a poser' (Deco > Objets deco branch, 60 items) contains gres/ceramic serveware-style pieces (bowls, trays, plates) whose product types visually overlap with Vaisselle/Assiettes, Vaisselle/Bols, Plats-moules-et-saladiers/Saladiers and Plats-de-service - these are two genuinely different, separately-URLed nav branches (Deco vs Arts de la table), so both are emitted per Rule 0.6 rather than dropped as a facet re-cut. Rule 0 gains: kept Eclairage d'exterieur (outdoor lighting, filed under the Jardin/garden branch, all 3 leaf children), Appliques murales (wall lighting) and Luminaires enfant (children's-room lighting) purely on product type despite room-associated names/placement, per Rule 0.1/0.2; kept Salieres/poivrieres/vinaigriers as tabletop serveware even though one of its 4 SKUs (Le Mortier, a mortar) is a functional kitchen tool, since the node's primary purpose (salt/pepper/vinegar table vessels) is tableware, not a hardware/cookware category - flagged in that row's evidence.
